name: Wind speed (50 m)
description: Change in wind speed (50 m) per decade in each grid cell, 2000-01 to 2026-09; solid colour = significant after correcting for testing many cells at once (FDR 10%), faded = not significant.
bounds_note: outer edges of the edge cells (cell centres +- half a cell); image row 0 = north
slope_units: % of the cell's mean per decade

scale.colors: red = increase, blue = decrease, white = no change
scale.rendering: nearest-neighbour; one pixel per grid cell

method: Per cell: monthly series, seasonal cycle removed (calendar-month means subtracted); Sen's slope vs time in years, x10 per decade; two-sided Mann-Kendall test with the Hamed & Rao (1998) variance correction using the significant autocorrelations (at 0.05) of lags 1-4 of the ranks of the Sen-detrended series - the same computation as the app's /trend default (stats.analyze, method='corrected'), vectorised over cells; cells with gaps use stats.analyze directly. Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.1 across all unmasked cells; 'significant' = passed FDR. Relative change = Sen's slope / the cell's mean over the period x 100.
mask: cell centre inside the Natural Earth 1:110m contiguous-US polygon and at least 50% of the cell is land on the GLDAS 0.25-degree land grid (removes ocean, Great Lakes and mostly-water coastal cells)
